methodology: Original engineering synthesis of publicly available, first-party documentation. This is not an official Microsoft reference architecture or a vendor endorsement.
Reviewed means the cited page was inspected, not that a cloud deployment or a performance benchmark was executed.
Recommendations are starting points subject to residency, licensing, source authorization, connector version, and measured workload tests.
Contoso scenarios are illustrative. Latency and concurrency values are design inputs, not product guarantees.
Recheck the linked limitations before implementation. Vendor capabilities, release status, quotas, regions, and prices change.
